error.message: invalid_grant: Token has been expired or revoked.

remediation: Re-run the Google OAuth flow for the Search Console scope (https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly).
Overwrite ~/.openclaw/credentials/google-oauth-tokens.json with the new access_token + refresh_token (keep client_id/client_secret).

Alternative: switch this report to use the service account at ~/.openclaw/credentials/google-service-account.json after granting it Restricted user access in Search Console > Settings > Users and permissions.
